congress-legislation.quote: You’re right. I personally was against Obamacare. Another Bernie flaw was his fear of confronting Obama, even though his 2016 campaign was really a referendum on his presidency.

Bernie never advocated “seizing the means of production” + his platform was meant to fit the American system, not overthrow it. He didn’t believe in ending borders or prison abolition or Senate abolition or public funded trans whateverectomies…

Bernie’s most radical proposal was Medicare for All. He was, in his own weird way, patriotic and optimistic. His idea of politics  back then was finding funding for regional air traffic control or VA burial benefits. He tried to be realistic, work the margins.

Bernie’s big weakness was that he hated economics and didn’t understand it at all — but he’s a financial genius compared to these NextGen DSA types, and shame on him for genuflecting to their insanities.
